title: Castle
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- sky/ground glow base -->
  <rect x="8" y="82" width="84" height="12" rx="4" fill="#2a4a7a"/>
  <!-- main castle body -->
  <rect x="30" y="45" width="40" height="38" fill="#c0c8d4"/>
  <!-- main castle wall texture/bright face -->
  <rect x="32" y="47" width="36" height="34" fill="#d8e0ec"/>
  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x="18" y="35" width="18" height="48" fill="#e8a040"/>
  <rect x="20" y="37" width="14" height="44" fill="#f0b860"/>
  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x="64" y="35" width="18" height="48" fill="#e8a040"/>
  <rect x="66" y="37" width="14" height="44" fill="#f0b860"/>
  <!-- left tower roof -->
  <polygon points="27,15 15,35 39,35" fill="#4090e0"/>
  <polygon points="27,18 18,34 36,34" fill="#60b0f8"/>
  <!-- right tower roof -->
  <polygon points="73,15 61,35 85,35" fill="#4090e0"/>
  <polygon points="73,18 64,34 82,34" fill="#60b0f8"/>
  <!-- main castle top battlements -->
  <rect x="30" y="38" width="10" height="10" fill="#d8e0ec"/>
  <rect x="45" y="38" width="10" height="10" fill="#d8e0ec"/>
  <rect x="60" y="38" width="10" height="10" fill="#d8e0ec"/>
  <!-- battlements color detail -->
  <rect x="31" y="39" width="8" height="8" fill="#b0bcc8"/>
  <rect x="46" y="39" width="8" height="8" fill="#b0bcc8"/>
  <rect x="61" y="39" width="8" height="8" fill="#b0bcc8"/>
  <!-- main gateway -->
  <rect x="42" y="62" width="16" height="21" rx="8" fill="#5a3a7a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="64" width="12" height="17" rx="6" fill="#7a5aaa"/>
  <!-- gate arch top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="8" fill="#5a3a7a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="#7a5aaa"/>
  <!-- left tower window -->
  <rect x="25" y="48" width="5" height="7" rx="2" fill="#2a4a7a"/>
  <rect x="26" y="49" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#80c8ff"/>
  <!-- right tower window -->
  <rect x="70" y="48" width="5" height="7" rx="2" fill="#2a4a7a"/>
  <rect x="71" y="49" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#80c8ff"/>
  <!-- flag on left tower -->
  <line x1="27" y1="15" x2="27" y2="5" stroke="#f0b860" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="27,5 38,8 27,12" fill="#ff6080"/>
  <!-- flag on right tower -->
  <line x1="73" y1="15" x2="73" y2="5" stroke="#f0b860" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="73,5 84,8 73,12" fill="#ff6080"/>
  <!-- ground grass -->
  <rect x="6" y="83" width="88" height="7" rx="3" fill="#40b040"/>
  <!-- path -->
  <rect x="44" y="83" width="12" height="7" fill="#a08060"/>
  <!-- friendly face on castle (optional cute) -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#2a4a7a"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#2a4a7a"/>
  <path d="M46 58 Q50 61 54 58" stroke="#2a4a7a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
